authorization: Owner requested execution after the concise Notion update.
scope: Design identifiability, HPCS source/annotation robustness, and native-assembly alternate-transcript TSS sensitivity. Source-informed descriptive follow-up, not independent confirmation.

hpcs.mapping_rule: Read the pinned author notebook defining labels. Use only explicit author correspondences; never fit a majority-vote mapping to the evaluated cells. Retain cluster categories where no explicit state mapping exists.
hpcs.composition: All 5333 retained traced cells, all 22 source aliases, all original state categories and any alternate/unassigned categories. Keep zero counts and the full source denominator for every annotation.
hpcs.weighting: For each group and category report equal-source and cell-pooled estimates. Omit each source in turn and recompute both. Ranges are sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals. No resampling cells as independent biological units.
hpcs.design: Source-level rows. Compare rank of library indicators with rank after adding chase or driver indicators, overall and within drivers. Tabulate library/group support. Rank is a necessary check, not proof of biological independence or causal identification.
hpcs.annotation_checks: Pairwise source/group contingency tables, source-level disagreement and changed composition after explicit mapping; do not interpret agreement among related labels as independent validation.
hpcs.no_inference: No p-values, transition rates, independent-animal counts, new state classifier or current mScarlet inference. Chase-library rank dependence was observed before freezing this follow-up.

histone.annotation: Reuse the exact cached CHM13 RefSeq Liftoff v5.3 GFF and its frozen SHA256; no GRCh38/MANE coordinates are transported.
histone.tss_rule: For each of the 23 frozen, unique primary-chromosome genes, retain every transcript feature explicitly parented to that gene, with matching exact symbol/chromosome/strand and boundaries inside the gene. Convert 1-based inclusive features to 0-based half-open; plus TSS=start, minus TSS=end-1. Deduplicate coordinates, retain all transcript IDs, and add the original gene-boundary TSS as an explicit baseline. No dominant-isoform/MANE preference is inferred.
histone.signal: Reuse exact interval integration, zero-filled uncovered bases, and separately reported coverage. Match state/CUT H3 controls; require both means positive and both coverages >=0.8. No pseudocount, spike-in/global-occupancy claim or population p-value.
histone.summary: Report all raw-mark, H3 and adjusted effects; per gene/mark/contrast/window/CUT report eligible alternative TSS count, effect range, exact direction changes versus the baseline and held comparisons. Report both preparations. Exact sign differences near zero remain descriptive, not a new significance threshold.

resources.network: At most two pinned author text/notebook files, <=20 MiB each. Do not execute downloaded notebook code.
resources.assay_payload: Use existing local metadata, annotations and 24 BigWigs; no expression matrix or raw sequencing download.
resources.outputs: Fresh tables, figures and run records; refuse overwrites. Preserve prior output hashes.

validation: Hand-calculated tests for weighting/omissions, explicit label mapping and strand-aware transcript TSSs; independent reconstruction of source statistics and design ranks; baseline equality to existing histone tables; independent base-resolution checks on alternate TSS windows; visual figure review; source/input/output hashes and repository checks.
